Tranquilizer pistol.name: Tranquilizer pistol
Tranquilizer pistol.description: A compressed-gas pistol that fires darts loaded with a fast-acting sedative. A clean hit brings an average adult down within a minute; large bodies and unusual physiologies can take several darts. Police and licensed heroes carry it when a target has to be taken alive and unhurt. [ Weapon | Licensed heroes and police only ]
